{{Citation}}
An '''envoy''' was a diplomatic title and occupation used by various different groups and organizations throughout the history of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Envoys were known to transport people of importance, provide security and employ [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] across the galaxy.

The [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and the [[Church of Infinite Perception]] both employed envoys.<ref name="Traitor Among the Chiss">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20171017-0|text=First Look: 'Traitor Among The Chiss' Teaser}}</ref><ref name="GG6-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
